name: Identity compromise response
description: Five-layer worked-example projection of the identity-compromise CACAO playbook. Drives an operator through triage → MFA reset → session revocation → lateral-movement hunt → IAM audit, joined to the SecOps-NG detection / control / telemetry / metrics layers. CACAO v2 + SecOps-NG content-model extensions.

action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: triage_identity_signal
action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Hydrate the originating identity-protection signal with principal context and decide whether to enter containment or close as benign.

action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: reset_mfa_and_revoke_sessions
action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Force re-enrollment of MFA factors and revoke all live sessions, refresh tokens, and persistent device grants for the principal across IdP and downstream SaaS tenants.

action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: lateral_hunt_and_iam_audit
action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Hunt for downstream activity attributable to the principal within the configured lookback window and remove residual persistence (rogue OAuth grants, app passwords, conditional-access exceptions, standing-privilege role assignments).

sources: SigmaHQ — upstream identity-protection rules (referenced, not re-authored)
MITRE ATT&CK — Credential Access (TA0006), Lateral Movement (TA0008)
ENISA Threat Landscape — identity and access management
NIS2 Directive — Article 21 risk-management measures, Article 23 incident reporting
DORA Regulation — Article 17 ICT-related incident management, Article 19 reporting of major incidents
